front.title: Live Reference Resolution: A Result Shape for Reads of an Authority by an Autonomous Agent

abstract.t: An agent that answers from a cached or derived copy of a value, when the system that owns the value has since changed, gives a wrong answer with no sign that it is wrong. This document describes the result an agent returns when it reads a value from its authority. Another component can rely on it. The result carries the value, the identifier of the authority that answered, a freshness indicator and a provenance type, bound together so that the value cannot be obtained without them. It also describes the behaviour around that result: resolving at the point of use, treating an unobservable or stale authority as an explicit uncertainty state, and refusing or escalating a costly act that depends on an uncertain value. The document is Informational. It defines no wire protocol, it has one in-house implementation of part of the result and no other, and it is offered for review as an Independent Submission.
